parsed.rationale: Two near-duplicate computed properties (Jaccard 0.75) both map `ProcessInfo.ThermalState` cases to human-readable strings: `ProcessInfo.ThermalState.description` in the sample-app `DebugHUD.swift` (line 237) and `PerformanceControls.thermalStateLabel` in the production `PerformanceControls.swift` (line 152). Because both live in the same `Wallpaper` package, the canonical fix is to add a single `var description: String` extension on `ProcessInfo.ThermalState` in a shared file within `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/` (e.g., `Extensions/ProcessInfo+ThermalState.swift`), then delete the local implementations in both files. The sample-app record carries `is_sample_app: true`, which normally suggests no-action, but the production file is not a sample-app file and the logic is clearly shared domain knowledge about thermal state labels, making consolidation worthwhile.
